title: The specified action-site internal-Hom comparison is natural
statement: For a small site (C,J), a site autoequivalence s whose inverse is continuous, a sheaf R of commutative rings and a ring identification a for inverse translation, fix a twisted action-site Presentation P [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. Let U be P.modules.functor followed by forgetPairs(sigma J s R a). There is a natural isomorphism from the uncurried internal-Hom bifunctor of P.coefficient followed by U to U.op.prod U followed by the uncurried internal-Hom bifunctor of R. At every pair (op M,N), its forward component is exactly P.hom(M,N).hom. This assertion concerns only naturality of the specified ordinary internal-Hom maps.

proof.text: The map of the uncurried internal-Hom functor is the composite homObjMap(f,id) followed by homObjMap(id,g). The proved homObjMap composition formula and identity laws identify it with homObjMap(f,g). The forgetful functor of fixed pairs maps an algebra morphism to its underlying module morphism. Therefore P.hom_naturality gives the naturality equation between these uncurried functors.

theorem hom_comparison (P : Presentation J s R a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ forgetPairs (sigma J s R a)
    ∃ H : Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := P.coefficient)) ⋙ U ≅
        (U.op.prod U) ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := R)),
      ∀ M N : Modules P.coefficient, H.hom.app (op M, N) = (P.hom M N).hom
